notes: This page only shows which numbered bags (1-5) make which sub-assemblies: minifigures and trolleys, platform, two waiting shelters, and the ticket booth. It has no building step, and a safety warning is printed on it. No pieces are placed.
This page gives tips only: sort the bricks on a table, and open the bags one at a time. It has no building step, so no pieces are placed.

Step 3 shows the five minifigures being assembled from hat, head, torso and legs. Their part numbers are not in the visible part of the parts list and not in the catalogue, so I recorded no minifigure pieces. Check the list for the minifigure pieces and add them if they are there.

Step 4 builds the hand truck: a tan 2x2 brick (the parcel), a sticker on its side, the red hand-truck frame and the black wheel pair. I recorded the wheel pair as one lego-2496, as in the parts list. The sticker is recorded as lego-59818, the sticker sheet, with colour 'Any'.
The brick-to-frame connection is a loose fit, so it is a join only. Nothing clutches, so the brick and frame have an empty rests_on.
Step 1 places the grey 4x6 plate. Step 2 fits a black 1x4 wheel-holder plate under each short end of it. The second holder is already in place in the picture, so there are two.
I gave b5 a rests_on of b6 and b7 because the holders clutch its underside. They are listed after b5 because the plate is shown first, and they carry an empty rests_on.
Step 3 adds two red 1x2 jumper plates, each over one stud-column position. Step 4 puts a black clip tile on the stud of each jumper.
The four small black wheels do not appear yet, so I expect them on a later page.

Steps 1-4 build the handle unit. A blue pin goes into the side of the 2x2 pin-hole plate, and two red jumper plates sit on the plate. A grey bar goes onto the pin, a 1x2 side-handle plate goes on the jumpers, and a dark grey grille tile goes on top. Two black handlebars clip onto the side handles.
I identified the grey plate with side handles as lego-2540, and the ridged top piece as the dark grey 1x2 grille tile lego-2412b. The picture is small, so these are my best reading.
Step 5 lowers the whole unit onto the two clip tiles b10 and b11 on the trolley base. The exact clip grip is unclear, so I recorded the two clip tiles as joined to b12.
Step 6 puts four small black wheels onto the pegs of the two wheel-holder plates, b6 and b7. The picture shows three already fitted and one going on.

Step 7 joins four straight track pieces end to end. Two spare track pins from the pack are thrown away and not recorded. The trolley is then set on the track, shown near the far end. I took that end piece to be the last one (b28), but it may straddle the joint with b27.

Correction to page 6: the unplaced count of Light Bluish Gray 2412b grille tiles fell from 3 to 2, while the Dark Bluish Gray count stayed at 5. So the grille tile b18 on page 6 is Light Bluish Gray, not Dark Bluish Gray as I recorded.

The left panel is the start of bag 2: the sheet of parts for the platform (two 2x10 plates, two big plates, four 1x16 black bricks). The platform is the model in step 2 of the overview. Nothing is placed from that panel.

Step 1 places a 2x10 light grey plate with a yellow cheese slope on the stud at one end. Step 2 adds a second 2x10 plate parallel to it with a gap of about 4 studs. A dark grey 1x8 plate (3460) bridges them across the end. Step 3 adds two black 2x8 bricks across both plates, one at each end.

The small details are my best guess from the drawings. The two thin plates are 2x10 (lego-3832), the bridging plate is the dark grey 1x8 and the two bricks are black 2x8. The right brick may only partly cover the 1x8 plate.
Correction to page 8: the unplaced count of White 1x8 plates (3460) fell from 6 to 5, while the Dark Bluish Gray count stayed at 8. So the bridging plate b32 is White, not Dark Bluish Gray.

Step 4 extends each long strip with another 2x10 plate: b35 continues b29 and b36 continues b31. Each pair is butted end to end, and the middle black brick b33 straddles the joint. I could not edit b33's rests_on, so the join is given in other_joins.

Step 5 adds a black 2x8 brick across both new plates. On the upper strip it adds a black 1x4 brick and a tan 1x2 brick with a side pin. I read the black piece as a 1x4 and which strip is which from the drawing, so those are my best readings.
Step 6 puts a black 2x8 brick across the left end of the frame. It also adds a black 1x4 brick and the second tan 1x2 pin brick on the upper strip, mirroring the first pair added on page 9.

Step 7 extends each strip to the left with a 2x16 light grey plate. The unplaced count of 2x10 plates is zero and two 2x16 plates remain, so I took these to be lego-4282. Each plate is butted onto the end of the strip it continues, and b40 straddles the joint.
The part types and positions are my best readings of the drawings.

Step 8 puts a black 2x8 brick across the far left end of the frame, over both new plates, and a yellow cheese slope on the end of the upper plate. This mirrors the right end, where the first slope sits.

Correction to page 10: the unplaced 2x16 plate (4282) counts changed from 4 black and 2 light bluish grey to 2 black and 2 light bluish grey. So the two plates I recorded as b43 and b44 are Black, not Light Bluish Gray, even though the drawing looks grey.
I put the yellow slope on the upper end plate b43. Its exact stud is my best reading.

Step 9 adds a black 4x2 18-degree slope at the front end of each of the five black 2x8 cross bricks (b45, b40, b37, b33, b34). Each slope clutches its brick and the front plate under it. The ramps stick out past the front edge of the platform. Which front plate sits under each brick is inferred from the earlier pages.

The '2x' box adds two yellow cheese slopes: one on the upper end of the right-hand brick b34 (shown going on) and one on the upper end of the left-hand brick b45. The left one is my reading, because the drawing shows two yellow slopes at that end.
The 4x2 slope footprint is only partly visible, so the plates I listed are my best guess.
The '2x' box adds two dark grey 1x8 plates (lego-3460). One lies along the top of the left-hand brick b45 and one along the top of the right-hand brick b34. The arrow points to the right-hand one.

The drawing also shows a long black wall along the back edge, which was not in the previous page, and a tan 2x2 brick near the middle. The step has no callout for them, so I guessed. I read the wall as two black 1x16 bricks, though it may be 36 studs long, and the tan brick as lego-3003. The 'rests_on' lists for those three are my best guess. Check them against the next page's unplaced counts.
Correction to page 13: the unplaced White 1x8 plate count (3460) fell from 5 to 3 while the Dark Bluish Gray count stayed at 8. So the two end plates b57 and b58 are White, not Dark Bluish Gray.

Step 11 adds a 2-wide black layer in front of the back wall, about 32 studs long. I read it from the drawing as a black 2x8 brick at the left, two black 1x16 bricks side by side in the middle (the two seams are 16 studs apart), and a black 2x8 brick at the right. A second tan 2x2 brick (lego-3003) is added in front.
The rests_on lists for the new layer are my best reading, since the layer is hard to see against the cross bricks. The 2x16 black plates and the other black 2x8 bricks are still unplaced.

Step 12 adds a black brick layer along the front of the platform, in front of the two layers added on page 14. The drawing shows it as three black segments. The black 2x8 count (3007) is now 2, so I read the segments as two 2x8 bricks plus the one black 1x8. Together they only make 24 studs, though the layer looks about 32 long, so I may have missed a piece or misread the lengths. Check this against the next page's unplaced counts.
The rests_on lists are my best guess, because the plates and cross bricks under the new layer are hard to see.

This page starts a new sub-assembly, probably the first waiting shelter (bag 2). Step 1 places a light grey 4x8 plate. Step 2 adds a white 2x6 plate down the middle, and two yellow round pillars on yellow bases. Step 3 adds two dark grey 1x3 plates at the corners and a light grey corner panel. Step 4 adds red round plates on studs, one on top of the right pillar, and a second light grey corner panel (shown going on).

Several identifications are guesses from small drawings: the square bases under the pillars are recorded as yellow 1x1 round bricks (3062b), and the grey pieces as 6231 corner panels. The pillar is lego-43888. The red round plates are clusters I read as five on the base and one on the pillar top.
The 2x6 white plate is placed on the 4x8 plate, leaving a dark-stud border at the front and back. The rests_on lists are my best reading.
Step 13 places the shelter sub-assembly from page 16 (4x8 plate b67 with its pillars) on the right end of the platform. No new pieces are added.
The unplaced counts match what I recorded on page 16 (4x8 plates, 2x6 plates, yellow round bricks, pillars, 1x3 plates), so those readings look right.
I could not tell exactly which layer bricks the 4x8 plate clutches, so I recorded b62 and b66 as my best guess.

Page 18 repeats the page 16 shelter-base build, with small differences: there is no red plate on top of the right pillar, and the red plates form two pairs. This is the second shelter, so the two bases are not the same copy.

Step 1 is a light grey 4x8 plate. Step 2 adds a white 2x6 plate and two yellow pillars on yellow round bricks. Step 3 adds two dark grey 1x3 plates at the corners. Step 4 adds four red round plates and two light grey panels. One panel is already shown in place and one is shown going on with two arrows.
I read the panel already in place as a 6231 corner panel and the one going on as a 4865a 1x2x1 panel, from the shapes. Those two are guesses, as are the rests_on lists.

Step 14 places the second shelter base (page 18, b83) on the platform. It also shows a light grey 4-wide plate in the gap between the two shelter bases, which was not in the previous picture. I read it as a 4x8 light bluish grey plate, so I added it as a piece. Check the next page's 4x8 count (3035) to confirm.
The rests_on lists are my best guess, since the layers below are hard to tell apart in the drawing.
Page 20 builds a third base of the same kind as pages 16 and 18, with a different top: no white strip.

Step 1 is the last light grey 4x8 plate, matching the 3035 count falling to 0. Step 2 adds two yellow pillars on yellow round bricks. Step 3 adds two dark grey 1x3 plates at the corners and two dark grey grille tiles on the plate. Step 4 adds a red round plate on top of the left pillar and a black 1x4x2 bar handrail at the right edge.
I read the ridged tiles as dark bluish grey 2412b grille tiles and the handrail as lego-6187. The rests_on lists are my best guess.

Correction to page 20: the unplaced count of Light Bluish Gray 2412b grille tiles fell from 2 to 0 while the Dark Bluish Gray count stayed at 5. So the two grille tiles b105 and b106 are Light Bluish Gray, not Dark Bluish Gray.

Step 15 places the third shelter base (page 20) at the left end of the platform. It adds four red 2x2 seats: two on each of the first two bases, seated over the white strip and red plates. A light grey 1x2 plate goes across the tops of the two neighbouring pillars of bases 2 and 3 (b87 and b102), shown with two arrows.

I treated the seats as resting on the base plate and white strip of their shelter. I could not see the seat clutch points exactly, so rests_on is a guess. The positions of the pillars and seats were read from the perspective drawing.

This is a small separate sign unit. Step 1 is a red 1x10 plate and step 2 puts a dark grey 1x8 plate on it. Step 3 adds a red bracket, a dark grey clip plate at the left end, a light grey 1x2 plate and a white clip plate at the right end. Step 4 puts a black 1x8 groove tile on top and a white 1x4 tile on the front, with a 'LEGO CITY' sticker. Step 5 hangs a yellow '1' tile on the left clip. A black side-handle plate carrying a white 2x2 tile and a blue 2x2 sign tile clips onto the white clip at the right end.
The step 3 parts are small and ambiguous. I read the left gray piece as the dark grey clip plate 6019, because step 5 hangs the '1' tile on it. The light grey 1x2 plate is a guess.
The stickers (the 'LEGO CITY' text and the arrow sign) belong to the sticker sheet 59818, which I already recorded as b2, so I did not add them as new pieces.
Step 16 lifts the sign unit from page 22 onto the tops of two pillars, one from the second shelter base (b88) and one from the first (b71), so it spans the gap between them. No new pieces are added.
Correction to page 22: the unplaced White 1x8 plate (3460) count fell from 3 to 2 while the Dark Bluish Gray count stayed at 8. So b115 is White, not Dark Bluish Gray.
The counts for the other page 22 pieces (white and blue 2x2 tiles, 1x4 tile, red 1x10 plate, red bracket, clips, black tile and side-handle plate) match what I recorded.

Steps 1-6 build a small blue ticket machine: a light grey 1x2 plate, two blue headlight bricks, two blue cheese slopes on their side studs, a light grey bracket, and a blue brick on top. The green screen is a sticker, so it is not a separate piece. Step 17 presses the machine onto the left shelter base next to the handrail.
The machine is small and shown at an angle, so the part types are my best readings.

Count check: from the page 23 list, two yellow cheese slopes (54200) remain unplaced although I recorded four yellow ones (b30, b46, b52, b53). Two of those may be misreadings, perhaps slopes of another colour or ones I counted twice. Blue 54200 is already used up in that list, so the blue slopes here may have been used before this page. Check this against later pages.
The platform now looks fully covered by the four light grey 4x8 plates (b67, b97, b83, b98).
Correction to page 24: the unplaced 44728 bracket count shows the Black one used and the Light Bluish Gray one still unplaced. So b131 is Black, not Light Bluish Gray.

Correction to page 24 (uncertain): the yellow 54200 cheese slope count fell by 2 on that page and no blue ones are listed. So b129 and b130 are probably Yellow, even though the drawing shows blue, and earlier colour counts have also differed from the drawings. Earlier yellow slopes b30, b46, b52 and b53 may also be miscounted.

Step 18 puts the timetable board on the right end of the platform. It is a dark grey 2x4 slope, a clear brown 1x4x3 panel, a white 1x4 tile on top and a timetable sticker (not a separate piece). The platform picture also shows six new pillars. I read them as yellow pillars on four yellow round bricks and one yellow 1x2 brick that carries the double pillar. The six count matches the unplaced pillars, but the bases are a guess.
The rests_on lists for the new pillars are my best guess.
Step 19 puts roof pieces over the pillars from pages 16-25 and builds a small fan unit.
Fan unit (inset): a red bar-up 1x2 plate, a light grey 1x2 plate, a yellow 2x2 45-degree slope, a grey pin and the black propeller. It is pressed onto the platform near the handrail.

Roof: the drawing has no callout for it, so the pieces are guesses. I saw a long dark grey rail along the back (read as four dark grey 1x8 plates, resting on the red-topped pillars), a light grey slab on the left, and another on the right. I read the left slab as a 2x16 plate plus a 2x8 and the right as a 2x8. The unplaced counts on the next page will show which are right.
The rests_on lists on the roof pieces are my best guess. The middle rail pieces have an empty rests_on because I could not see what supports them.

Step 20 puts three black 6x8 10-degree sloped roof panels on the roof frame from page 26: two side by side on the left and one on the right. The unplaced count of 4515 bricks confirms three, though they are not used up on this page's list.

Corrections to page 26, from the unplaced counts: only two Dark Bluish Gray 1x8 plates were used, not four, so b153 and b154 were not placed. One Black 2x16 plate (4282) was used, and no Light Bluish Gray 2x16 plate. So b156 is probably the Black 4282, not Light Bluish Gray. Two 30586 plates were used, which is what I recorded. One of b157 and b158 is probably wrong, or one of the three roof strips is one of those pieces.
I could not confirm which pieces carry which roof panel. The rests_on lists are guesses.

The left panel is the start of bag 3: two black long plates, two big light grey plates, and a yellow 1x16 brick. The finished model is the yellow shelter shown at the bottom of the panel. Nothing is placed from that panel.
Step 1 lays two black 2x16 plates side by side with a gap of two studs and a yellow 1x6 brick across the end. Step 2 puts a dark grey Technic 1x14 brick with side pin holes along one plate.
Count conflict: the unplaced list shows only one Black 2x16 plate (4282) left, but I recorded two here. One of them may be a different plate, so check the next page's count.
Correction to page 28: the unplaced counts fell by one Black and one Light Bluish Gray 2x16 plate (4282). So b163 is Light Bluish Gray, not Black.

Step 3 puts a second dark grey Technic 1x14 brick on the other plate and a red Technic 1x6 brick across the left end. The yellow 1x6 from page 28 is at the right end. Step 4 covers them with a light grey 6x16 plate and pushes two grey pins into the red brick (one already in, one going in).
The rests_on lists are my best reading, since the frame is seen from above.

Step 5 builds the yellow back wall along one long edge of the 6x16 plate: a tall yellow 1x1x5 brick at each end, a yellow 1x6 brick next to each, and a yellow 1x2 brick going into the 2-stud gap in the middle (shown with two arrows). The widths add up to 1+6+2+6+1 = 16.

Step 6 is drawn from the opposite side. It adds a white 2x6 plate on the plate and two small groups of red round pieces in front of the wall, plus one more yellow 1x2 brick on top of the wall near each end.

Count caveat: I read four red round pieces, but only three Red 1x1 round plates (6141) and one Red round brick (3062b) are left. I recorded three plates and the one round brick. The two extra yellow 1x2 bricks leave none of the three unplaced ones, so check that against the next page.
The rests_on lists are my best guess.
Step 7 adds a small light grey panel standing on the white 2x6 plate, between the two groups of red round pieces. The rest of the view matches page 30, so no other pieces are new.
Correction to page 30: the unplaced count of Green 1x1 round bricks (3062b) fell by one while the Red one is still unplaced. So b182 is Green, not Red, even though it looks red in the drawing.
I read the grey panel as lego-4865a, which is my best guess from the shape. It is the same panel seen in the shelter bases on earlier pages.

Step 8 puts two red 2x2 seats on the white strip, one on each side of the grey panel, and a light grey corner panel (shown going on) between them. A black 1x4x2 handrail goes at the right end of the plate.

Step 9 is drawn from the opposite side. It puts two clear 1x6x5 panels on the back wall, a yellow 1x2x5 post between them, a second yellow 1x2x5 post at the right end, and a yellow 1x1x5 post at the front left. The yellow 2x2 and 1x1 posts are my reading from the drawing, and the exact positions are uncertain.
The rests_on lists are my best guess.

Step 10 caps each end of the ticket booth with a yellow 1x6x2 arch, resting on the two end posts. The inset adds two dark grey round 1x1 bricks, one stacked on the other, on the free stud of the front-right post.
The unplaced counts match what I recorded on page 32: 1x1x5 posts, 1x2x5 posts, clear panels and seats.
The rests_on lists for the arches are my best guess.

Correction to page 33: the unplaced Dark Bluish Gray 1x1 round brick count fell from 8 to 7, so only one was used there. One of b195 and b196 was not placed. Treat b196 as not placed and the stack as a single round brick b195.
Step 11 lays two yellow 1x16 bricks along the top of the booth, resting on the two end arches. Step 12 adds a black 1x2 brick with a side handle on top of the round brick at the right end.
The beams resting on both arches is my best reading of the drawing.
Step 13 bridges the two yellow roof beams with cross bricks. A yellow 2x6 brick is already in place across the middle, and a yellow 1x6 brick (two arrows) is going onto the beams next to it.

The drawing is small and the arrows are ambiguous. I read the placed cross piece as a 2x6 and the hovering piece as a 1x6, so those sizes are best guesses. The next page's unplaced counts for 2456 and 3009 will confirm.

Step 14 caps the ticket booth with a light grey 6x16 plate on the roof beams and cross bricks. The inset builds a small lamp: a trans-yellow round plate, a white inverted dish on top of it, and a dark grey clip plate on the dish. The lamp clips onto the black handle brick (b199) at the right end under the roof.
The unplaced counts match what I recorded on page 35: 2x6 bricks went from 6 to 5 and 1x6 bricks from 17 to 16.
The left panel is the start of bag 4, the second ticket booth. It shows two black long plates, two big light grey plates, and a yellow 1x16 brick.

Step 1 lays two long plates side by side with a red Technic 1x6 brick across one end. Step 2 puts a dark grey Technic 1x14 brick along one plate. This repeats the start of the first booth on pages 28 and 29, with the red end placed first.

Count conflict: only one 2x16 plate (Light Bluish Gray) is left unplaced, but two plates are shown, and both look black. I recorded both as Light Bluish Gray 4282, but one may be a different part or colour. Check against the next page's counts.

Step 3 adds the second dark grey Technic 1x14 brick on the other plate and a yellow 1x6 brick across the far end, opposite the red end. Step 4 covers the frame with a light grey 6x16 plate. This repeats pages 28 and 29, but this booth has no pins in the red end.

Correction to page 37: the unplaced Light Bluish Gray 2x16 plate (4282) count fell by one only. So only one of b206 and b207 is a 4282. The other is some other long plate that I could not identify, so b207 is probably the wrong type.
The rests_on lists are my best reading of the frame.

Step 5 stands two tall yellow 1x1x5 posts on the 6x16 plate at its two back corners. It also adds a yellow 1x6 brick along the left back edge and a yellow 2x6 brick across the middle of the plate. This booth is built differently from the first.
The 1x6 and 2x6 identifications come from the stud patterns. The unplaced counts for 3009 and 2456 will confirm on the next page.

Step 6 adds a second yellow 1x6 course on the back wall, and a yellow 1x2 brick going on the first course next to the left post (two arrows). I read the brick as a 1x2x2 with inside axle holder, because no plain yellow 1x2 brick is left unplaced.
It also adds two stacked dark grey round bricks and a dark grey grille tile on the yellow 2x6 block.
The part types are guesses from small shapes. The next page's counts for 3009, 3245b and the round bricks will show what is wrong.

Step 7 adds a counter on the yellow 2x6 block: a keypad slope (the cash register) and a white 2x2 tile. It also adds a blue and a green headlight brick, each with a light grey tap pushed into its side stud, shown in the two insets.
The unplaced counts match what I recorded on page 40: grille tiles, round bricks, 1x2x2 bricks and 1x6 bricks.
The positions on the counter are my best reading, so the rests_on lists are guesses.
Step 8 adds the last clear 1x6x5 window panel on top of the back wall, and a yellow 1x2x5 post at its right end, beside the counter.
The unplaced counts match what I recorded on page 41: the headlight bricks, taps, keypad slope and white tile are all used.

Step 9 builds a two-high stack of white cupboards at the left of the booth, each with a clear-blue door (the '2x' box), plus a yellow 1x2x5 post at the left end. A dark orange croissant goes in the lower cupboard, and two small can pieces, each capped with a light grey round plate, go in the upper cupboard. The drawings of the cans are small.

Count conflict: the Green 1x1 round brick (3062b) was already used up on page 30, yet a green can is shown here. So the green can may be a different part, or my earlier assignment of the green brick on page 30 is wrong. I recorded it as a green 3062b anyway.
The two yellow posts at the right end are b213 and b214 from page 39 seen from the other side, so I did not add them again.
The rests_on lists for the cupboards are my best reading.

Corrections to page 43, from the unplaced counts: the Dark Bluish Gray 1x1 round brick count (3062b) fell by two there, and Red and Green round bricks were already used up before page 43. So b236 and b237 are probably Dark Bluish Gray, not green and red. The Light Bluish Gray round plates (6141) fell by only one and the Trans-Yellow ones by one, so b239 is probably Trans-Yellow, not Light Bluish Gray. The cans in the drawing look green and red, but the counts say otherwise.
